title: Fleet Console
description: A concept console for AV test-fleet oversight that puts coverage gaps, open incidents and unreviewed footage on the first screen, and makes escalation independent of any one person.
hmw: make AV test-fleet oversight visible before it fails?

facts.label: My part
facts.value: Proposed the concept and did its UX research, design and prototyping

facts.label: Context
facts.value: Self-initiated concept at Woven by Toyota. This is an NDA re-creation with invented data.

facts.label: Status
facts.value: Concept. Nothing shipped, no outcome metrics, and the outcome is internal.

facts.label: Process
facts.value: Directed through [Design-crew](/work/design-crew/), built afterward and not used at Woven

heroImages.alt: Fleet Console motion reel: the Now screen, an escalation acknowledged, the iPhone takeover, then an in-vehicle tag.

image.alt: The Now screen: a re-routed escalation, a coverage bar with gaps drawn, and span of control against the 15:1 baseline

blocks.text: Test fleets grow faster than their oversight
Leads can't see oversight debt, and escalation hangs on one phone call. Public reporting on AV test programs describes this; I used it as design pressure, not evidence.
One drives. One is the safety net.

cards.label: Operator, in the car
cards.value: Flags an issue in a glance, then triages it later with data.

cards.label: Lead, remote
cards.value: The human safety redundancy: follows up incidents, audits footage, answers emergency calls.

image.alt: Information architecture: six navigation verbs on top (Now, Inbox, Owned, Review, Fleet, Plan) over objects underneath, with Incident as the canonical page.

blocks.text: Organize around “what needs me now”, not the data
Navigation is verbs and queues; objects sit one hop below. I rejected object-first and time-first.

cards.label: Workflow-first IA
cards.value: Chose verbs and queues over object lists, because the hardest jobs are “act now” or “see now”.

cards.label: Now owns debt
cards.value: Chose a plain sum with its arithmetic shown over a composite score, because leads must reproduce it by counting.

cards.label: Escalation rota
cards.value: Chose a rota that re-routes on timeout over a fixed on-call field, because that field is a single point of failure.

cards.label: Protocol-gated resolve
cards.value: Chose five unskippable steps over “not applicable” toggles, because those hand judgment back to a tired lead.

cards.label: No green
cards.value: Chose shape plus label over color-only dots, because hue never carries meaning alone.

cards.label: Preview width
cards.value: Chose dropping the Vehicle column over horizontal scroll, because Status, Owner and Age are the triage signals.

blocks.text: Each surface gets the job it's best at

blocks.text: Plumb: color is meaning, never the only signal
There is no green: severity uses shape plus a label. Two density modes, light and dark.

items: The 2-second glance floor is measured, not eyeballed.
